EA_M2_ECB.units: Millions of EUR, SA, end of month

JP_M2_BOJ.title: Japan M2 (BOJ)
JP_M2_BOJ.units: 100 millions of JPY, NSA, monthly average outstanding

CN_M2_PBOC.title: China M2 (PBoC)
CN_M2_PBOC.units: 100 millions of CNY, NSA, end of month
CN_M2_PBOC.source: People's Bank of China, Money Supply table (pbc.gov.cn)

global_m2.title: Global M2 (US + Euro area + Japan + China) in USD
global_m2.method: Each economy's M2 converted to USD with the monthly average of the FRED H.10 daily rate (DEXUSEU, DEXJPUS, DEXCHUS). Total computed only for months where all four components AND all FX averages exist; no forward-filling. Note: definitions differ (US monthly avg SA, EA end-of-month SA, JP monthly avg NSA, CN end-of-month NSA).

JP.source: Bank of Japan stat-search API MD02/MAM1NAM2M2MO

CN.source: People's Bank of China, Money Supply table (pbc.gov.cn)
